scope.campaign: Current RelayCatalog U1-U400, progressionVersion6; held-out U401/U573/U721/U1000
scope.engine: Unmodified Board + MoveBudget policy6 + ElementalShell121 + ExitChain121 + EconomyCurve121
scope.assistance: Native U1 first2-exit coach, rendered exact dead-end warning, and explicitly requested one-use earned Focus are environment cues; cue sources are recorded for selected traces and exposure counts are recorded for every attempt. No hidden solution, safety suffix or solver state enters agent search.
scope.energy: Runtime-matched in-memory pacing ledger: starts10; U1-U10 free; 1 per U11+ start/retry; refill1/600 modeled seconds; capacity raises without grant. Persistence, clock rollback and purchase receipts excluded.
scope.economy: Starts180 coins; first-clear current stars/rewards; first2 undo free then current coin price; no action refund on undo. No IAP, ads or purchased continuations.
exclusions: Companion skills and ownership/evolution/home/summon navigation are not simulated; collection/exploration interests affect declared utility only
Inventory powers, login/quest/tutorial-completion/avatar rewards, real money, ads, events and multiplayer excluded
No rendering, accessibility comprehension, touch motor behavior, actual emotion, actual IQ or addiction diagnosis
Utilities, learning and timing coefficients are explicit uncalibrated hypotheses; no human distribution or target D1/D7 fitted
One available modeled session per day; no real-time notifications or social acquisition

config.timeUnit: Modeled seconds/minutes/days; runtime separately in provenance

utilityCoefficients.returnProbability: sigmoid(2.4*startUtility) times exogenous daily availability; day0 forced
utilityCoefficients.stopProbability: 1-sigmoid(3.5*continueUtility), checked every5 actions or between completed boards after4 actions

metricDefinitions.completionRate: Mean across trajectories of completed campaign levels / started attempts, including failed/retried/horizon-censored starts; not campaign completion
metricDefinitions.meanLevelsCleared: Mean unique sequential campaign levels cleared per trajectory, capped at400
metricDefinitions.blockedRate: Mean trajectory blocked taps/all decision interactions, including shell/Focus/Undo; not only productive exits
metricDefinitions.modeledD1: Share of synthetic trajectories with a modeled session on day1 (day0 starts forced)
metricDefinitions.modeledD7: Share of synthetic trajectories with a modeled session on day7, not continuous retention
metricDefinitions.meanSessionMinutes: Mean trajectory mean duration of modeled sessions
metricDefinitions.meanOverrunMinutes: Mean trajectory mean max(0,sessionMinutes-plannedMinutes); behavioral hypothesis, not addiction diagnosis
metricDefinitions.meanKnowledge: Mean declared five-rule knowledge state at horizon; not a psychometric score
metricDefinitions.ci95: Profile-cluster bootstrap of synthetic paired differences; no human calibration or population prediction

profiles.generation: Independently shuffled Latin-hypercube strata per dimension; arbitrary uniform ranges, no human norming. Fictional IQ-like label separately permuted and never used in behavior.
